zh: 咱们做企业的老板，忙着做新媒体跑渠道。
en: As business owners, we are busy making media and building sales channels.

zh: 搞产品升级，拼命到处找客户。
en: Upgrading products, desperately looking for customers.

zh: 但有没有想过一个残酷的现实。
en: But have you considered a harsh reality?

zh: 下一个行业十字路口，你的企业能不能存活下来。
en: At the next industry crossroads, can your business survive?

zh: 拼的可能不是现在的业务成绩。
en: What matters may not be your current business results.

zh: 而是你整个组织有没有完成，AI底层改造。
en: It may be whether your entire organization has completed its AI overhaul.

zh: 获客没问题，做产品没问题。
en: There is nothing wrong with customer acquisition or making products.

zh: 获客也没问题。
en: And there is nothing wrong with customer acquisition, either.

zh: 但绝大多数企业，AI还停留在老板自己玩。
en: But in the vast majority of firms, AI is still something only the boss plays with.

zh: 或者是只是剪视频，写文案，当个工具用。
en: Or it is only used to edit videos and write copy, just as a tool.

zh: 这根本不叫AI转型。
en: That is not AI transformation at all.

zh: 那什么是真正沉下心的深度AI改造。
en: So what is a truly focused, in-depth AI overhaul?

zh: 不是买系统，不是上软件。
en: It is not buying a system or installing software.

zh: 是打通每一个部门，落到每一个人。
en: It is connecting every department and bringing it to every person.

zh: 让公司的每一个岗位，都成长为独立的超级个体。
en: Let every role in the company grow into an independent super-individual.

zh: 销售，运营，行政，生产，业务。
en: Sales, operations, administration, production, and business.

zh: 每一个环节，全部嵌入AI工作率。
en: Every part, all embedded in the AI work rate.

zh: 不是可选，是全员必用。
en: It is not optional. Everyone must use it.

zh: 改造的初期呢，你看不出爆发式的业绩。
en: Early in the overhaul, you do not see explosive business results.

zh: 也看不出立刻变现的结果。
en: Nor do you see results that turn into money right away.

zh: 很多老板呢，就是做两个月，看不到收益呢。
en: Many bosses work at it for two months and see no returns.

zh: 就直接放弃了，觉得AI是噱头。
en: Then they give up outright, thinking AI is a gimmick.

zh: 但这恰恰是最关键的沉淀期。
en: But this is precisely the most crucial period of laying the groundwork.

zh: 我现在做的呢，就是给整个公司换一套。
en: What I am doing now is giving the whole company a new

zh: 底层的操作系统。
en: underlying operating system.

zh: 等到AI大市场爆发的那天。
en: When the big AI market takes off,

zh: 行业规则被彻底倒逼重构的时候。
en: when industry rules are forced into a complete restructuring,

zh: 别人的团队手忙脚乱，临时补课。
en: other teams will be scrambling and cramming at the last minute.

zh: 内部流程全部脱节。
en: Their internal processes will all be disconnected.

zh: 人才跟不上的时代。
en: An era that talent cannot keep up with.

zh: 被市场卷的进退两难的时候。
en: When market competition leaves them unable to advance or retreat,

zh: 而你的公司全员已经熟练，用AI思考协作干活。
en: everyone in your company is already skilled at thinking, collaborating, and working with AI.

zh: 每个人都是一个高效的超级个体。
en: Each person is an efficient super-individual.

zh: 那么个体能力的叠加，合力推着整个公司向前冲。
en: Then individual abilities add up, together pushing the whole company forward.

zh: 别人呢是被迫追赶。
en: Others are forced to catch up.

zh: 你就是那个提前布局，第一个吃螃蟹的人。
en: You are the one who prepared ahead, the first to take the plunge.

zh: 未来呢，企业的竞争。
en: In the future, competition between businesses

zh: 早已经不是产品和渠道的，单点对比。
en: is no longer a single-point comparison of products and channels.

zh: 是整个组织AI化程度的较量。
en: It is a contest of how AI-enabled the whole organization is.

zh: 早改造不一定马上赢。
en: An early overhaul may not bring an immediate win.

zh: 但不改造很可能在下一个路口出去。
en: But without one, you may go out at the next crossroads.

zh: 你的公司真的做好迎接AI时代的准备了吗。
en: Is your company truly ready to welcome the AI era?

zh: 如果你的公司想做全员AI深度改造。
en: If your company wants an in-depth, company-wide AI overhaul

zh: 又不知道从哪里开始的。
en: but does not know where to start,

zh: 评论区留下你的行业，给你详细拆解。
en: leave your industry in the comments, and I will break it down in detail.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州深耕企业AI落地服务。
en: I am Chao Ge, focused on enterprise AI implementation services in Lanzhou.
